dedupe_keys.name: voies et routes de la commune d ajaccio

description: Voies et routes de la commune d’Ajaccio is a dataset listed in data.corsica open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by CAPA-Communauté d'Agglomération du Pays Ajaccien. Liste des voies et des routes se situant sur la commune d’Ajaccio, reprenant différentes informations comme le code Rivoli, le propriétaire, le libellé, la longueur,etc... Coverage: Corsica. The portal files it under Territory & Development. Its keywords are route, voirie, réseaux de transport. The portal shows 2,354 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-11-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-corsica-portal.
